lines.text: The LORD tells Moses that a woman who bears a son will be unclean for seven days.
On the eighth day the baby boy is to be circumcised.
After a son, the woman continues in purification for forty days and must not go into the sanctuary.
After a daughter, she is unclean two weeks, then purified sixty-six days, and brings a year-old goat for a burnt offering.
If she cannot afford a lamb, she brings two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and the priest makes atonement.
